name: Spoofed CAN Message Injection
description: An attacker injects fake CAN bus messages to impersonate a legitimate ECU.

name: Unauthorized OTA Firmware Injection
description: An attacker pushes malicious firmware disguised as a legitimate OTA update.

name: Bluetooth Pairing Exploit
description: An attacker exploits a Bluetooth pairing flaw to gain access to the Infotainment ECU.

name: Unauthorized Diagnostic Session
description: An attacker with physical access opens a UDS diagnostic session without authorization to read or modify ECU data.

name: Backend API Credential Theft
description: An attacker steals vehicle authentication credentials to impersonate the vehicle to the backend server.

name: Replay Attack on Diagnostic Commands
description: An attacker captures and replays a previously valid diagnostic command to trigger unauthorized ECU actions.

name: Denial of Service on Gateway ECU
description: An attacker floods the Gateway ECU with traffic, preventing legitimate OTA updates or CAN traffic from passing through.

name: Location Data Interception
description: An attacker intercepts unencrypted location data sent from the TCU to the backend server.

name: Malicious Mobile App Exploiting Bluetooth Link
description: A compromised paired smartphone app sends malicious commands to the Infotainment ECU over Bluetooth.

name: Firmware Rollback Attack
description: An attacker forces the Gateway ECU to roll back to an older, vulnerable firmware version.

name: CAN Bus Eavesdropping
description: An attacker with access to the CAN bus passively reads sensitive vehicle data without authorization.

name: Backend Server Compromise
description: An attacker gains control of the backend server, allowing mass OTA update manipulation across vehicles.
